summary: Iteration-18 validated per-country couriers, EUR normalisation, COD-first payments, updated bank details, sub-labels, relevance ranking, fragmented street search, and full end-to-end order placement for the accelerated PreCheckoutModal. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass in test_iteration18_country_couriers.py (bank details=DSK/BG61STSA93000032400775/STSABGSF/Purepeptide LTD; /nextcart/countries returns exactly the 11 expected countries with default=BG and Bulgarian names; /nextcart/config per country returns the required couriers — BG: {econt,boxnow,pigeon}, RO: {fancourier}, GR: {speedex}, HU/PL/SK/CZ/SI/HR/IT/DE: {gls} — all methods currency=EUR and payment_methods[0].key=='cod' with is_default=true; /nextcart/pickups?provider=gls&country=HU returns offices, GR speedex returns offices, RO fancourier locker returns a well-formed response; POST /checkout succeeds with payment_method='cod' and rejects with 400 when terms_accepted=false). Frontend (Playwright on the public preview URL): the BG cart drawer flow opens the precheckout-modal with terms already accepted (no second checkbox); each courier tile carries its sub-label ('до офис', 'до кутия', 'до адрес') and they remain visible; Наложен платеж is FIRST in the payment list and pre-selected while pc-bank-details is hidden until Банков превод is chosen and then shows DSK Bank + BG61STSA93000032400775 + STSABGSF + Purepeptide LTD; Econt 'София' search returns 81 offices with the top-5 all city=София (relevance ranking OK, no 'София — София' duplication); Pigeon fragmented 'София Иван Вазов' street search returns 10 street results in Sofia and selecting one fills both city and street; the country selector switches couriers and methods correctly for RO/GR/HU/DE with prices shown in EUR and COD remaining the default; city placeholder is 'Град' — no '(предиктивно търсене)'. HOWEVER: the final order placement via pc-continue FAILS with HTTP 422 because PreCheckoutModal.jsx builds the /api/checkout `shipping` object WITHOUT the required `full_name` and `phone` fields — backend Pydantic model requires both.

integration_issues.flow: PreCheckoutModal → POST /api/checkout order placement (all countries, both payment methods)
integration_issues.issue: Request body's `shipping` object is missing the required `full_name` and `phone` fields → backend returns 422 with 'Field required' for shipping.full_name and shipping.phone. Order cannot be placed via the modal — checkout is completely broken. Frontend already has contact.first_name/last_name and a normalised `+dial+phone` value used as customer_phone; the same values must also be assigned to shipping.full_name and shipping.phone.

action_items: PreCheckoutModal.jsx placeOrder (~L372-377): add `full_name: `${contact.first_name} ${contact.last_name}`.trim()` and `phone` (the same normalised +dial+digits value already computed on L369) to the `shipping` object so it satisfies the backend's shipping schema. Without this fix the accelerated checkout is completely unusable from the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: PreCheckoutModal.jsx L372-377: `shipping` object is missing required `full_name` and `phone` → causes 422. Bug is silent in the UI: a red 'Field required' toast appears but users cannot recover because there is no UI field mapped to those errors.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx L375: `postal_code: (pickup ? pickup.postal_code : addr.postal_code) || '0000'` — falling back to '0000' when the courier office happens to have no postal_code can cause issues with country-specific validators (e.g. GLS/DE require 5-digit).

nextcart.py _shape_delivery: fallback GLS price is a hard-coded €8.99; for HU/PL/RO the upstream shows lower prices (7,37 / 8,28 €) — worth documenting or moving the fallback price to env so the merchant can adjust without a code change.
nextcart.py L26-32: COUNTRY_COURIERS is a source-of-truth constant; adding a courier per country still requires a redeploy. Long-term this belongs in DB/admin so ops can toggle without engineering.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx AddressSuggest.run (L161-203): the fragmented city-first resolve does up to 3 sequential /address-suggestions calls per keystroke burst; a shared in-memory cache keyed by (mode, q, place_id, country) would eliminate the 2 wasted 'no-hit' calls seen in every fresh query.

success_rate.frontend: 83% — every requested UI behaviour works EXCEPT the actual order submission which 422s

context_for_next_testing_agent: The end-to-end frontend order placement is blocked by a 2-line fix in PreCheckoutModal.jsx placeOrder (shipping needs full_name + phone). Once that is added, re-run the placeOrder Playwright flow — the /api/checkout request already carries the correct delivery{office,...}, terms_accepted:true and payment_method:'cod' so success page navigation should follow. All other iteration-18 requirements (per-country couriers, COD-first, sub-labels, EUR pricing, bank details, relevance ranking, fragmented street search, country switch, missing '(предиктивно търсене)' wording) are already verified. Testids used: precheckout-modal, precheckout-close, pc-first-name, pc-last-name, pc-email, pc-phone, pc-country, pc-dial, pc-couriers, pc-courier-{econt|boxnow|pigeon|fancourier|speedex|gls}, pc-method-*, pc-pickup-search, pc-pickup-results, pc-city, pc-street, pc-street-results, pc-number, pc-postal, pc-payment-cod, pc-payment-bank_transfer, pc-bank-details, pc-discount-code, pc-discount-apply, pc-total, pc-continue, cart-terms-checkbox, cart-checkout-btn.
rca of the issue: PreCheckoutModal.placeOrder (frontend/src/components/PreCheckoutModal.jsx L372-377) builds `shipping = { line1, city, postal_code, country }` and omits `full_name` and `phone`. The backend model (server.py near L200) requires those two fields on `shipping`. Result: every /api/checkout POST from the UI returns 422 with `{loc:['body','shipping','full_name'], type:'missing'}` and `{loc:['body','shipping','phone'], type:'missing'}`. Reproduction: 1) open /products/21-retatrutide-5, 2) Към количка → tick cart-terms-checkbox → cart-checkout-btn, 3) fill pc-first-name/last-name/email/phone, 4) pick an Econt office, 5) click pc-continue — toast 'Field required · Field required' appears; the same request from the pytest suite (which explicitly sends shipping.full_name and shipping.phone) succeeds with 200. Fix: in placeOrder, add `full_name: `${contact.first_name} ${contact.last_name}`.trim()` and `phone: phone` (the normalised value already on L369) to the shipping object.
